postReviewAmendment.authority: Root relay of the review (2026-10-18): fix H1, H2, M1-M6 and the lows in-PR as normative SHALL requirements with scenarios; extend the probe so the surviving mutants are caught; re-run RED/GREEN transparently. Owner standing instruction: "continue with recommended options and fix the issues that come up, publish as needed".

fixes.H1: user-identity ADDED "Operator Seat Writes Are Throttled Before Key Derivation" (route-wide, pre-KDF, not keyed by client address or forwarded header) + scenario "Operator password guessing is throttled".
fixes.H2: player-identity ADDED "Local Seat Routes Accept Only Loopback Same-Origin Requests" (loopback Host literal, Origin match when present, Sec-Fetch-Site same-origin/none, before body or KDF, local-seat routes only) + scenarios "Foreign Host is refused before the body", "Cross-site Origin is refused before key derivation".
fixes.M1: user-identity ADDED "Operator Seat Writes Are Idempotent and Generation-Fenced" (duplicate replays recorded outcome without re-applying a password; reused id with different non-secret parameters refused; stale generation refused without state change; fresh operation id per submit) + 3 scenarios; D14 retry sentence corrected (a true retry replays and keeps the originally applied password).
fixes.M2: player-identity: second concurrent mint refused immediately with retry-after, not queued, not a failed attempt; scenarios "Second concurrent mint" and "Mint racing a revoke" (no token; same refusal as a revoked seat).
fixes.M3: player-identity ADDED "Local Seat Credential Secrecy" (POST body only; no passwords/derived keys/private keys in URLs, logs, error payloads, operation records, campaign event journal, match history or responses; seat key encrypted at rest under the seat-password vault KDF; decrypted key not outliving the request; Cache-Control: no-store) + scenario "Mints leave no secret behind".
fixes.M4: player-identity and D14: token has "the same payload, scope and verifier semantics as the primary mint route at that head" (no U101 collision); D14 names U101a/U101c/U101d census.
fixes.M5: coop: explicit user action clears stored choice and bearer; refusal directs the user to it; scenario "Guest re-claims after re-provision".
fixes.M6: player-identity: lockout after 5 consecutive failures for 60 s (Root-recommended defaults pending the owner answer, server-side only); refusals of a locked seat run no KDF; failure count and lock durable; successful mint and re-provision clear both, revocation does not; scenario "Lockout threshold and clearing".
fixes.L1: coop: "only that public choice and the ordinary bearer in the existing per-match session store".
fixes.L2: D14: ghost membership of a revoked/rotated principal accepted and disclosed by LSC-2OP.
fixes.L3: D14: same-host denial of mint via the route-wide window accepted under the trust model.
fixes.L4: CF-LSC0-5 carried in the PR body.
fixes.L5: Probe blind spots recorded below; probe v2 closes them for the contract text; LSC-1 RED remains runtime tests (CF-LSC0-9).
fixes.L6: roadmapPlain/roadmapGit log hashes recorded above; review report hash recorded here.
